entities.summary: Sir Casimir Stanislaus Gzowski,, was a Polish Canadian engineer who was known for his work on a wide variety of Canadian railways, as well as work on the Welland Canal. He also served as acting Lieutenant Governor of Ontario from 1896 to 1897.
